name: Probando Lenceria
description:
beautiful young woman standing in a mall fitting room, in front of a triple
panel mirror showing her from three angles, wearing only pink lace lingerie
set, delicate bra and matching panties, garter straps, thigh high stockings,
long wavy hair, smooth flawless skin, full sensitive chest, soft blush on
cheeks, shy excited smile, knees together, hands nervously clasped in front,
newly feminine body she is discovering, mall changing room interior, white
curtain, wooden bench with folded clothes and shopping bags, hangers with
dresses on the wall, warm flattering light, pink and cream tones, sensual
intimate mood, photorealistic, cinematic lighting, depth of field, high
detail, 8k
